title: BIM / Archviz Reality Capture with 3D Gaussian Splatting (.splat)
description: Loads a captured building interior as a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene (.splat, baked RGB, no spherical harmonics) using GaussianSplatLoader. Splats are a first-class SceneModel primitive, so this photoreal as-built capture loads, streams and renders like any other model — the reality-capture point-of-truth you can orbit alongside CAD geometry in a BIM / archviz workflow.
